resources.string: Good to have you here. Choose your language first; setup only takes a few minutes.
A quick note first

Mayo TV is a player, like a TV without an antenna: it comes with no channels, films or playlists, and sells none. What you watch comes from your own provider, and you are responsible for making sure you are allowed to use it.
New here? Create your profile. Used Mayo TV before? Bring everything over from a backup or from another device.
Create a profile, then add your playlist
From a backup file, on this TV or sent from your phone
Your profile
Give the profile a name first: OK on Name opens the keyboard.
A PIN needs at least 4 digits. Leave it empty if you don’t want one.
Add your channels

Mayo TV has no channels of its own: they come from your IPTV provider. From them you have either a playlist link (M3U, often ending in .m3u) or an Xtream login with a server address, username and password. You’ll usually find it in their email or in your customer account.
With your phone
Recommended. Scan a QR code, then type or paste the details on your phone or computer.
With the remote, one field at a time
From a backup
Bring playlists back from a backup file
No provider yet? Then skip this step. You can add a playlist any time under Settings › %1$s.

1. Scan the QR code with your phone’s camera, or open the address in a browser. The phone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi.\n2. Enter the PIN and fill in the form.\n3. Send it. The details appear here on the TV, where you start the import with OK.

Pick what your provider gave you. Xtream: a server address, username and password. M3U: a single link, often ending in .m3u, or a file. Stalker: a portal address and a MAC address; only if your provider calls it that.
Send the file from a phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi
This usually takes just a moment.
Depending on your provider this takes a minute or two. No need to wait: let it carry on in the background and set up the rest meanwhile. Your channels will keep arriving.
Depending on your provider this takes a minute or two. You can start watching while the rest loads in the background.
Continue in background
Your channels are here
Only if your provider gave you a separate guide (XMLTV) address
Change details

No internet connection
MAC address not accepted
Can’t read the playlist file
Watch out for upper and lower case and for spaces at the end. Your username and password are in your provider’s message; on your phone you can paste them instead of typing.
Check the address character by character: it starts with http:// or https:// and often has a port such as :8080. The surest way is to paste it on your phone.
That’s usually down to the provider, not you. Wait a moment, then try again.
Check the Wi-Fi or the network cable in the TV’s settings, then try again.
Check your details, or try again later. “Test connection” on the form shows what the provider answers.
